fullPassage: When my daughter was two years old, we took her to a London Symphony Orchestra children's concert. At some point in the programme, the orchestra played Rossini's William Tell Overture, which was used as the theme tune of The Lone Ranger, and has come to represent the rhythm and excitement of galloping horses. Within seconds several thousand toddlers instinctively began delightedly bouncing up and down on their parents' knees in time with the orchestra. They had probably never heard the music before, and if they had, I doubt they would have linked it to memories of galloping cowboys. Music psychologists term such intuitive and immediate responses to music 'emotional contagion', as if one 'caught' an emotion, as in an epidemic. Despite their varying cultural and educational backgrounds, the children responded to the music in the same way, and instantly.

❌ ② calculated: '계산된'도 의식적 사고가 있으므로 반대.
❌ ④ rational: '이성적인'도 사고를 거치므로 반대.
det.tip: instinctive(본능적인) = done without thinking, automatic. ↔ deliberate, calculated.

questions.passage: Within seconds several thousand toddlers began bouncing up and down on their parents' knees. Music psychologists term such responses __________ (emotion) contagion.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에 명사 contagion이 있으므로 명사를 수식하는 형용사 필요. emotion(명사) → emotional(형용사).
det.tip: emotion(감정, 명사) → emotional(감정의, 형용사). -al은 형용사 접미사.

questions.passage: Despite their varying cultural and __________ (educate) backgrounds, the children responded to the music in the same way.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에 명사 backgrounds가 있고 앞에 cultural and가 있으므로 병렬 형용사 필요. educate(동사) → educational(형용사).
det.tip: educate(교육하다) → education(교육, 명사) → educational(교육의, 형용사). cultural and educational = 문화적이고 교육적인.

questions.passage: When my daughter was two years old, we took her to a London Symphony Orchestra children's concert. At some point in the programme, the orchestra played Rossini's William Tell Overture, which was used as the theme tune of The Lone Ranger, and has come to represent the rhythm and excitement of galloping horses. Within seconds several thousand toddlers instinctively began delightedly bouncing up and down on their parents' knees __________. They had probably never heard the music before, and if they had, I doubt they would have linked it to memories of galloping cowboys. Music psychologists term such intuitive and immediate responses to music 'emotional contagion', as if one 'caught' an emotion, as in an epidemic. Despite their varying cultural and educational backgrounds, the children responded to the music in the same way, and instantly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 오케스트라에 맞추어(in time with the orchestra).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ in time with the orchestra: '오케스트라에 맞추어' — 음악의 박자에 맞춰 뛰어오르는 행동을 설명.
❌ ① out of boredom: '지루함에서' — delightedly(기뻐하며)와 모순.
❌ ② against their will: '그들의 의지에 반하여' — instinctively + delightedly와 모순.
❌ ④ without any rhythm: '리듬 없이' — rhythm과 in time이라는 핵심 주제와 반대.
det.tip: in time with(~에 맞추어) = in sync with, in rhythm with.

questions.passage: When my daughter was two years old, we took her to a London Symphony Orchestra children's concert. Within seconds several thousand toddlers instinctively began delightedly bouncing up and down on their parents' knees in time with the orchestra. They had probably never heard the music before, and if they had, I doubt they would have linked it to memories of galloping cowboys. Despite their varying cultural and educational backgrounds, the children responded to the music __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 같은 방식으로, 그리고 즉시(in the same way, and instantly).
det.analysis:
✅ ① in the same way, and instantly: '같은 방식으로, 즉시' — 다양한 배경에도 불구하고(Despite) 동일하고 즉각적인 반응이라는 원문 그대로.
❌ ② differently depending on age: '나이에 따라 다르게' — Despite varying backgrounds + same way와 모순.
❌ ③ only after repeated listening: '반복 청취 후에야' — within seconds(몇 초 내)와 모순.
❌ ④ with confusion and fear: '혼란과 두려움으로' — delightedly(기뻐하며)와 모순.
det.tip: Despite(~에도 불구하고) + varying backgrounds → in the same way(같은 방식으로): 배경이 달라도 반응은 같다는 핵심 논지.
